title: Z-Score Calculator
description: Convert any value to a z-score from mean and standard deviation, with its percentile via the normal CDF.
howto: Enter the value x, mean μ and standard deviation σ.
Read the z-score, percentile and plain-English interpretation.

faqs.a: The value sits 2 standard deviations above the mean — roughly the 97.7th percentile.
With the standard normal CDF Φ(z) via the Abramowitz–Stegun approximation (accurate to ~1e-7).
Yes — negative simply means below the mean, e.g. z = −1 is the 15.9th percentile.
